chapter_title: Telos: Citadel Station, the stolen ship and the polar academy
about: Story state every completed run of the chapter ends with, for a skip-to-the-end feature. Curated in tools/questdb/chapters.py; values marked certain = false were worked out by reading the scripts or seen in one real save, not proven for every run.

journal.set_by: dialog holorec E0 (950cor); LostJedi is The Jedi Masters' quest, its stage 30 is set here
dialog 203lorso E48 (209tel); seen at 40 in the Game3 save
dialog 204habat E185 (204tel): the droid brain to the Ithorians
dialog 207luxa R125 (207tel): the money handed over
dialog 203slusk E26 (208tel): the Exchange leader leaves the Ithorians alone
dialog 202grenn E168 (202tel): escorted to the TSF
dialog samhan E78 (202tel): the smuggler arrested
dialog dotonhet E32 (207tel): won at pazaak
Yima's quest, the first ending (no setter found in the files; a conversation in scripts.bif or 201tel's own dialogs)

globals.name: 200TEL_B4D4_T1N1
globals.note: 1 from dialog 204habat E211 (a_set200b4d4t1n1), 2 from k_ptel201_enter; read by a_t3m4intro (303nar) for a line of slot 8. Left unchanged

globals.name: 200TEL_Control
globals.note: a_201shuttle (201tel), its only writer, on taking the shuttle: 1 on every path unless 203TEL_Czerka_Attack is 1 (the compound left under attack), then 2. The light run beats the attack (a_set204czerka: 0) or never starts it, so it ends at 1. Read by k_221tel_enter (221tel, The Jedi Masters): 1 places the Ithorian leaders (221_chodo, 221_moza) and militia, otherwise mercenaries

globals.name: 201TEL_Chano_Spawn

globals.name: 203TEL_Czerka_Attack
globals.note: the attack on the Ithorian compound: 1 while it runs (tr_moza_help, a_moza_czerka), 0 once it is beaten (a_set204czerka, 204tel), 2 when the player leaves on the shuttle during it (a_201shuttle). The light run beats it or never starts it: 0 either way

globals.name: 203TEL_Czerka_Call

cleared_note: How each module looks after a full run, for an editor that stores the area as played: remove (tag, template), doors (tag: open, unlocked), containers_looted (container tags the rewards file empties), locals (the area's, the module's and placed objects' local variables their own scripts read to tell a first visit from a return, with the value a played area holds; index = the engine's local slot). returnable = false: the player never comes back to the module. See tools/questdb/cleared.py.
returnable_note: after Telos the galaxy map (a_galaxymap, 003ebo) offers Citadel Station (planetary.2da row 10) but never Telos itself (row 9), so only the station modules 201-209tel can be visited again, until 221tel (The Jedi Masters) deletes their save group 6 (modulesave.2da). The shuttle to the restoration zone runs once (dialog 201shu E3 sets 201TEL_Shuttle_Ready 0), so 231-233tel are never entered again; 261tel and 262tel are reached again only late, by 006ebo (The Jedi Masters), and are not stored as played. 205tel and 211tel are not kept in a save (modulesave.2da includeinsave 0)
